messages:
jin: Heads-up: rack33 has a set of nodes (node07/node08) spiking PCIe AER + NVLink retrain events, observed throughput drop on the LLM pool. Can we triage?
ops-bot: created HW-7245 · link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/HW-7245 · assigned to eng-infra oncall
samir: seeing Xid 13 + AER multi-source logs in kernel: `pcie aerr: AER: Corrected error received: severity=corrected, type=transaction, id=0000` and nvlink retrain count incrementing on GPU0 lane2. metrics -> memory_errors.ecc.count +120 in last 10m.
alejandra: thanks. quick checklist: 1) isolate affected nodes, 2) drain tasks, 3) collect NVLink/PCIe counters + dmesg, 4) consider host reboot or slot RMA if hw flapping.
jin: current impact: 3% p99 latency regression for hosted text-gen route (route=llm-standard, model pinned=redwood-llama-70b). Traffic is sticky to rack33 due to affinity; draining will reduce regional capacity.
terry: suggest draining node07 first. use: `redwoodctl node drain rack33-node07 --force --timeout 15m` then watch KV cache miss rate. also capture `nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE,ACCOUNTING,ERR` and nvlink stats: `nvlink --query --device=0` (paste output to the ticket).
samir: paste of short dmesg excerpt: ```[1715009988.123456] pcieport 0000:04:00.0: AER: Corrected error received: id=0001, severity=corrected
[1715009990.987654] nvidia: -> nvlink retrain: lane2 timeout, retry 3
[1715010020.001122] Xid(13): Graphics Exception```. That matches the spike windows.
alejandra: if drain reduces capacity too much we can failover some routes to dedicated-capacity pool (costy) or enable burst capacity for 30m. need triage estimate before committing.
sre-oncall: acknowledged, starting drain on rack33-node07 now. ETA initial drain 12m. Will monitor p99 and cache hit. If retrains persist after reboot will schedule cold power-cycle and escalate to HW RMA for the card.
jin: note: similar pattern last month but resolved by reseating GPU on slot B. Can we check slot-level CRC counters and reseat if retrain persists?
terry: yes. if reboot doesn't clear AER we should coordinate brief maintenance window to HALT services on node, reseat GPU, then POST test. ops-bot, add checklist to HW-7245.
ops-bot: updated HW-7245: added steps -> collect nvlink logs, run `pciutils -vvv` and `lspci -vv` outputs, attempt soft reboot, if persists schedule rack tech reseat.
samir: quick note: ECC counts for node08 also rising but below threshold. recommend we keep node08 online but throttle heavy batching lanes (lower max_batch_size) to reduce stress.
alejandra: agreed. lowering batch config for llm-standard in region -> patch ready: `config set region-eu-llm-standard max_batch=8` (will rollout canary then global).
jin: canary now? we should only move after drain completes.
sre-oncall: drain completed for node07 at 1715010500. p99 back to baseline (within 0.5%). nvlink retrain events on node07 stopped after soft-reboot. node08 still shows intermittent AER traces, will keep throttled.
terry: schedule for reseat if node08 hits 3 more retrains in 24h. if that triggers RMA, budget note: expect 1 GPU RMA + 2hr tech time, related cost ~ $1.2k (parts + ops).
alejandra: ops action items updated on ticket. I'll coordinate capacity shift if we need longer drain. Thanks all :thumbsup:
jin: leaving this thread, will follow HW-7245 for updates.
